title: How to Read Your Swiggy and Zomato Payout Statement
excerpt: A restaurant on 24% commission can keep just 56% of its menu value. A line-by-line guide to Swiggy and Zomato payout statements, your real take rate, and a weekly reconciliation routine.
metaTitle: How to Read Your Swiggy and Zomato Payout Statement
metaDescription: Every deduction on a Swiggy or Zomato payout explained: commission, GST, discounts, ads, refunds and TDS, with a worked example and weekly reconciliation.
author: deepak-desh-bandhu
